Integrity chain summary
------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Primary acquisition (jsdelivr)   -> sha384 computed
2. Secondary acquisition (unpkg)    -> sha384 computed
3. Binary diff of primary vs. secondary  -> identical
4. Both sha384 values match index.html integrity attribute
5. index.html integrity attribute is the hash that the
   browser verified when S17 deployment was tested via Playwright.

Transitive trust: the browser verified the CDN-delivered file;
the local vendor file matches that verified file byte-for-byte;
and a second independent CDN returns the same file.

Threat model coverage:
  [x] jsdelivr MITM during our download  (caught by unpkg cross-check)
  [x] jsdelivr cache poisoning since S17 (caught by SRI match in browser)
  [x] Silent CDN replacement with malicious build
       (caught by two-origin bit-identical check)
  [ ] NOT covered: upstream npm compromise before S17 deploy.
      Mitigation: track upstream Bootstrap + ECharts security
      advisories; rotate vendor files on any CVE.
